How the Role Fits In The OT Server Engineer is responsible for the availability, reliability, and cybersecurity of servers and core infrastructure that support industrial control systems (ICS) and plant operations. This role focuses on lifecycle management of OT servers (physical and virtual), patching, backup/restore, disaster recovery, performance monitoring, and secure integration with DCS/SCADA/Historians, while adhering to industrial cybersecurity standards (e.g., ISA/IEC 62443) and plant safety protocols. This position interfaces with Operations, Maintenance Capital Projects, Process Safety, Reliability and Mechanical Integrity Groups to ensure appropriate alignment in the delivery and sustainability of PLC & OT device security at all three manufacturing sites. This position reports to the Operational Technology Team Leader, part of the Process Control and OT organization. Responsibilities and Accountabilities The position is accountable for understanding and putting into practice the INEOS 20 Principles.  Accountability: Server & Compute Infrastructure Maintenance Build, configure, and maintain OT servers in segmented OT networks Manage virtualization platforms (VMware vSphere/ESXi, Nutanix) and storage (SAN/NAS) supporting ICS applications. Maintain domain services (AD DS/OU/GPO design for OT), DNS/DHCP, NTP, and certificate services for OT trust boundaries. Health monitoring and alerting of server/computer equipment failures, alarms and warnings Establish and maintain KPIs for asset health, lifecycle and performance New server equipment installations and old equipment decoms  User management for servers/workstations and remote access  Implement IT and cybersecurity policies to meet Cybersecurity guidelines (IGGNs) Operational Technology (OT) server/system SME for all cybersecurity projects Support the site Digital System Specialists and Application Engineers in the selection, installation, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of their DCS servers and workstations Perform audits on all assigned process control networks and apply patches / keep system to date and maintain high availability Ensure initial configuration, upgrades and migrations of cybersecurity related software and hardware are working as planned (Anti-virus, Whitelisting, Backup and Restore, Monitoring Tools, Firmware and Patches, etc.) Assist with the design and implementation of disaster recovery and business continuity plans, procedures and audits Support all phases of assigned capital projects including equipment selection, installation, configuration, start-up, checkout, and supervision of personnel contracted for computer/server equipment installation. Responsible for identifying reliability issues and recommending solutions for system improvements. Able to support the OT Network Engineer with cisco equipment, firewalls and other network gear when needed. Education and/or Experience Education Bachelor’s degree related to Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology Minimum of 5 years of operational support experience in enterprise and/or OT infrastructure supporting chemical manufacturing/plant operations Working knowledge of information security standards, frameworks, risk assessment and best practices from ISA99, IEC62443, NIST882. Key skills and competencies are Client Service Oriented, Skilled in partnering with internal customers at all levels to define problems, identify solutions, and facilitate change Impact and influence - able to persuade others to a particular course of action Teamwork - shares accountability for team results and utilizes interpersonal skills to improve team performance Analytical and conceptual thinking - able to understand both the details and the underlying systemic issues to plan and implement creative and effective solutions to business challenges Innovative and information seeking - monitors internal and industry trends to identify new opportunities. Organizes work effectively and uses available resources Anticipate problems and adjust accordingly Demonstrated ability to manage progress and deliver on multiple and competing priorities. Ability to manage multiple projects, activities and tasks simultaneously Experience with data protection, business continuity and disaster recovery options, configuration and execution Experience with support of IT/OT systems, including network implementation & segmentation, PLC's and field devices, and IT systems preferred Possess knowledge on Cisco Networking & Virtualization platforms such as VMWare, VXRail, vSAN and NSX. Willingness to learn and develop new skills
